label: Priority split: PRIOR_4 (priority in being) and a single-sense pure-act route needing one bridge
summary: #1751 slice 2 (specs/priority-in-being.toml) registers lane B's respect fork of simple priority (PR #1769, item (d) 4). New sense PRIOR_4 of DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME (sense 11d1b100, definition f4365b55, Lean PriorityInBeing.PriorInBeing W y x := W y x ∧ ¬ W x y, the In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 15 criterion over the primitive CanBeWithout; sourced by claim ab5ec574). PRIOR_1 to PRIOR_3 are unchanged; the originals 47aff057, 97fa3a0b, 70e98bb5 and 74eb9113 are unchanged. The PRIOR_4 siblings are ec5ffe6b (the n. 15 criterion, definitional: result b00b452a, no premises), c4bb0481 (sibling of 47aff057, derived from 000e1f65, 8ab3d114 and excluded middle: result 94dc553f), 6eacb281 (sibling of 70e98bb5, from c4bb0481 and 5dacb0db: result af233664) and c51a07a1 (sibling of 74eb9113, from the premises of f8992ef7 with 6eacb281 in place of 70e98bb5, by the existing theorem firstMoverIsFirstBeing: result 3c795147). 5dacb0db has no priority term and needs no sibling. Bridge 954fe018 (open): a first unmoved mover first in PRIOR_4 is first in PRIOR_1. Result fb8fba1e derives 6c18d52b (pure act) from c51a07a1, 954fe018 and a4d3261a under adopted POTENCY_1, composing firstMoverPureAct with non-overlap discharged by the adopted sense; its only passage from PRIOR_4 to PRIOR_1 is that bridge, and the semantics preflight (truth semantics from the semantics-preflight branch, PR #1767) fails the same argument without the bridge. Argument 3e2366b5 is unchanged and single-sense in PRIOR (PRIOR_1); its legacy POTENCY_1/POTENCY_2 mixing is unrelated. The sense split shows that its first-being premise 74eb9113 has a split-respecting derivation only through the bridge. The only other support, f8992ef7 via 70e98bb5, runs through 47aff057 on one relation. The premise-free sense-mixing control 27599762 shows that PRIOR_4 is asymmetric by definition, so priority from actual moving (the shape of 6ca87431) read as PRIOR_4 excludes every reciprocal cross-respect moving case. All six results use no axioms (excluded middle is an explicit premise of 94dc553f and 3c795147) and pass Comparator and NanoDa. The new sibling c51a07a1 lists 777646a5 (CAUSE_1 to CAUSE_2) and 101bdd62 (MAXIMAL _6 to _1) as sense bridges; these mixings come from f8992ef7, where they are allowlisted legacy. Frontier: one bare premise is added on both roots (954fe018), and four support alternatives are added.
blocker:
Not done:
- The respect-sense uses e078f07b, 6ca87431 and a4d3261a keep PRIOR_1. A respect-indexed relation (priority in act in respect r) is not introduced. The respect-free PRIOR_1 still meets the slice-1 reciprocity certificates.
- The bridge 954fe018 is open and is now the crux of the pure-act step.
- An alternative bridge was not formalized: a PRIOR_4 reading of act's priority ('whatever is in POTENCY_1 in r has something in act in r prior to it in being'). It would make the bridge unnecessary, but it faces reciprocal cross-respect moving.
- Spine II's 931319ea (47aff057 with PRIOR_1) and the order statements 7ad36aca and 32d77f18 have no PRIOR_4 siblings yet.
Next tests:
- Defend or refute 954fe018 against the firstWayDoesNotYieldPureAct model: is a being in act in a respect in which a first unmoved mover is in potency thereby prior to it in being?
- Re-bind spine II to PRIOR_4.
